{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify and exclude sentinel values
sentinel_value = -999.0
valid_data = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_final'] != sentinel_value]

# Compute the mean of biomarker_final for valid entries
mean_biomarker_final = valid_data['biomarker_final'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_biomarker_final"}
